body_markdown:
The start of a new school year brings a lot at once — new students, new schedules, and a long list of operational details that all need to be in place before the first bell rings. For the teams running cafeterias, school stores, and payment systems behind the scenes, a little preparation now goes a long way toward a smoother August and September.


Whether your district is a long-time i3 Education partner or just getting started, here are a few areas worth a quick check before the year kicks off.


###### **Make Sure Your Team Feels Ready**


New school year, new staff, and sometimes new cashiers who have never touched a POS terminal before. Refresher training goes a long way toward confident, accurate transactions from day one — whether that’s a quick walkthrough for returning staff or a first-time training session for someone brand new to QuikLunch or QuikApps. A well-prepared team means fewer questions at the register and a much calmer first week.


###### **Check Your Hardware Before You Need It**


Few things slow down a cafeteria line faster than equipment that’s aging, glitchy, or missing altogether. Taking stock of terminals, printers, and card readers now — rather than in the middle of a busy lunch period — gives your team room to address any gaps before students are back in the building.


###### **Revisit Meal Application Best Practices**


Accurate, timely meal applications set the tone for the entire year, from Free & Reduced status to federal reporting deadlines. A quick refresh on best practices for collecting and processing applications early can help your district avoid a late-fall scramble to catch up on verification and documentation.


###### **Trust the Systems Behind the Scenes**


Families and staff are trusting your district with sensitive information every time they make a payment or submit an application. i3 Education’s PaySchools platform is independently audited and SOC 1 & SOC 2 certified, giving districts confidence that the systems behind their cafeteria and payment operations meet a high standard for security and data protection.


###### **You’re Not Starting From Scratch**


None of this needs to be figured out alone. Between training resources, hardware guidance, and a team that understands the rhythms of a school year, districts have support available at every step — not just during the first hectic weeks of school, but throughout the year ahead.


***Here’s to a smooth start and a great year for every district getting ready to welcome students back!***
